_comment: Hand-maintained league format/rules. convert_bigboard.py merges this into bigboard.json under leagues.<league>.rules. Edit here, not in generated JSON.

keepers.cost_rule: Keeper costs 2 rounds earlier than the round in which the player was drafted the prior season (e.g. drafted round 8 -> kept at a round 6 cost).
keepers.eligibility: Player must have been drafted the prior season. Players added via waiver/free agency (undrafted) cannot be kept.

keepers.cost_rule: Keeper costs 3 rounds earlier than the round in which the player was drafted the prior season (e.g. drafted round 8 -> kept at a round 5 cost).
keepers.eligibility: Same as Kepners: player must have been drafted the prior season. Undrafted players cannot be kept.
keepers._note: Keeper count assumed same as Kepners (2) -- not explicitly stated when these rules were captured. Update this if Miami actually differs.

zimmer._format_note: Zimmer switched from auction to snake for 2026. The auction cockpit is fully preserved -- set format back to 'auction' here and it reactivates, no code change needed.
zimmer._teams_note: Derived from 2025 ESPN draft history team names -- ESPN teams get renamed between seasons, so verify/update before the real draft. slot=null until the snake draft order is drawn.
zimmer._roster_note: 2026: 9 starters (QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/FLEX/DEF) + 7 bench = 16 drafted. Changes from auction era: 2 WR (was 3), kicker removed, 2nd FLEX added. Plus 1 IR slot, tracked in irSlots -- excluded from rosterSlots because it isn't draftable.
